title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
slides: Is Google designing the death of shared entertainment?
A patent describes AI generating personalized video feeds per viewer
The feed could rewrite plot points based on your reactions
Your favorite show may never be the same twice
Ask who controls the algorithm curating your taste
thread_text:
1. Google's patent rewrites plots

A new patent describes AI that generates a personalized video feed for each viewer, adapting plot points based on your reactions.

2. Your reactions shape the story

The system could rewrite scenes in real time, meaning your favorite show might never be the same twice.

3. Shared entertainment disappears

If everyone gets a different version, watercooler moments vanish. No one sees the same show.

4. Who controls your taste?

The algorithm curating your feed decides what you see. That's a lot of power over culture.

5. Ask who controls the algorithm

Next time you watch, ask: who decides what you see? Try to spot the algorithm's influence.

instagram.caption:
Google filed a patent for AI that generates a different video feed for every viewer, rewriting plot points based on your reactions. 🎬

Your favorite show might never play the same way twice.

If everyone sees a different version, the shared moments that spark conversations disappear.

For creators, that means the story you publish isn't the story your audience sees. 😳

Who controls the algorithm curating your taste? Next time you watch, ask who decided what you see. 🤔
